name: Llamarush
tagline: LLaMaRush is built to solve one of the biggest problems startups and small teams face: managing SEO without time, expertise, or expensive tools
description: LLaMaRush is built to solve one of the biggest problems startups and small teams face: managing SEO without time, expertise, or expensive tools. Most founders are busy building products, not analyzing keywords or planning content. LLaMaRush works like an AI SEO co-founder that takes over this entire process. It automatically studies your website, identifies real growth opportunities, and creates a weekly content plan based on what will rank fastest. With smart keyword clustering, and direct CMS
